column1: # crates/app/src/board_editor/smoothing.rs
市販の基板のように、配線の角を丸め、太さが変わる所をなだらかにし、パッドに入る根元を垂直にそろえ、鋭角で分かれる2本の間のくぼみの先を丸くします。配線そのものは変えずに、表示とガーバーだけに反映します。ここは基板全体の設定です。ネットごとに変えるときは、ネットの設定窓 (銅をクリック) のネットクラスで
column2: Like a commercial board: rounds track corners, smooths places where the width changes, straightens the ends entering pads, and rounds the notch between two tracks that split at a sharp angle. The tracks themselves are not changed; only the display and the Gerber are. This is the setting for the whole board. To change it per net, use the net class in the net settings window (click the copper)

column1: 同じ太さの配線がつながる角を、円弧にします。角が丸いと電流が流れやすく、高周波でも反射が減ります。直線に近い角や、短くて入らない角は小さくなるか、そのままです
column2: Turns corners between tracks of the same width into arcs. Rounded corners carry current more easily and reflect less at high frequency. Corners that are nearly straight, or too short to fit an arc, get a smaller arc or stay as they are

column1: 半径
column2: Radius

column1: 太い配線と細い配線がつながる所と、配線がパッド・ビアに入る根元に、中間の太さの短い配線を挟みます (パッドより細い配線は、根元がパッドの幅から配線の太さへ徐々に細くなります)。電流が急に絞られず、配線の根元が割れにくくなります
column2: Inserts short tracks of an in-between width where a wide track meets a narrow one, and where a track enters a pad or via (a track narrower than the pad tapers from the pad's width to the track width). The current is not squeezed suddenly, and the track's end is less likely to crack

column1: 1つの点から2本の配線が鋭い角度で出ている所の、細いくぼみ (エッチング液がたまりやすい所) を銅で埋めて、先を凹んだ丸い形にします。T字の内側の角や、同じネットの並走が1本にまとまる所のすき間も同じです。配線の経路は変わらず、表示とガーバーにだけ働きます (確定はできません)
column2: Where two tracks leave one point at a sharp angle, fills the narrow notch (where etchant tends to collect) with copper and gives it a rounded concave tip. The same for the inner corners of T-joints and the gap where parallel tracks of the same net merge into one. The track paths do not change; this affects only the display and the Gerber (it cannot be made permanent)

column1: 同じ所へ並んで走る2本の配線の間の細いすき間 (エッチング液がたまりやすい所) を、銅の多角形で埋めます。見た目と製造の整えだけで、電気には要りません。形が崩れる所があるときは切ります (初期は切)
column2: Fills the narrow gap between two tracks running side by side to the same place (where etchant tends to collect) with a copper polygon. It only tidies the look and manufacturing; it is not needed electrically. Turn it off if it breaks shapes anywhere (off by default)

column1: パッドの根元をそろえる
column2: Align pad entries

column1: すべての配線の、四角いパッドへの根元を、パッドの辺に垂直な短い区間にそろえます。配線の経路が、パッドの近くだけ少し変わります。ルール違反が増える所と、接続が切れる所は変えません。整えを切ったネットクラスのネットは除きます。自動配線の直後には、新しい配線に自動で行います (②の「パッドに垂直に出入り」が入っているとき)。元に戻すで取り消せます
column2: Makes every track's end at a rectangular pad a short section perpendicular to the pad's edge. The track path changes slightly, only near the pad. Places where this would add rule violations or break a connection are left as they are. Nets in net classes with tidying turned off are skipped. Right after autoroute this is done automatically for the new tracks (when "Enter and leave pads straight" in ② is on). You can undo it
